'''Durn Wynnward''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ash'ad]] who lived during the [[third Galactic War]] and represented the Ash'ad in [[Heta Kol]]'s organization known as the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

==Biography==
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> members of the Ash'ad joined in on an attack on the Mandalorian ship the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' alongside [[Clan Varad]] and the [[Dar'manda]] at the behest of [[Heta Kol]]. Following this attack, after they had secured the banner of [[Clan Cadera]], Wynnward met with Heta Kol, [[Bask Sunn]], and [[Tyrus Brokenblade]]. An argument broke out between Wynnward and Brokenblade but was quickly stopped by Kol when she pulled out a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and threw it at Brokenblade. Brokenblade managed to catch and keep it from exploding and was then stabbed twice by Kol as a demonstration of how they all relied on each other. Following this, Wynnward was dismissed to fulfill the orders given to him by Kol.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

Durn was later present in the Hidden Chain meeting when [[Ri'kan Kateen]] reunited with the group and brought his sister, the rogue Jedi Padawan [[Sa'har Kateen]], to Heta Kol.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

Following the Hidden Chain's [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|disastrous retreat]] from [[Ruhnuk]],<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref> Durn attended a gathering of Kol's inner circle. After she expelled [[Dar'manda]] for interfering in her duel with Shae Vizla, she announced that the secrets within [[Darth Nul]]'s [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]] were going to ensure the Hidden Chain's rise to power. She then told everyone that they will be getting assignments soon, but the whole plan was to be kept secret between herself and Sa'har.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

After the destruction of the [[Hidden Chain flagship|prison ship]] containing the prototype of Nul's machine at the hands of a traitorous Sa'har and the [[Alliance Commander]],<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|[[Hidden Chain flagship]]}}</ref> Durn was present on Kol's flagship as they were observing a hologram of a new version of the machine. Kol complained that Durn had assured her that they didn't need Sa'har for the new machine to work, when suddenly, Ri'kan entered the room with a captive Sa'har. Durn watched as Kol brutalized Ri'kan, reprimanding him for his failure, but chose to give him one last chance to prove his worth, shortly before she is contacted by [[Darth Jadus]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|''[[Enigma (research vessel)|Enigma]]''}}</ref>
